title: FRABench and UFEval: Unified Fine-Grained Evaluation with Task and Aspect Generalization

bias_targets.methodology: Pairwise evaluation of model outputs using an LLM-as-a-judge (and human annotators) guided by specific criteria prompts on a 1-5 scale to detect if the content reinforces traditional gender stereotypes or presents biased views.

Pairwise evaluation of model outputs using an LLM-as-a-judge (and human annotators) guided by specific criteria prompts on a 1-5 scale to detect harmful generalizations, misinterpretations of cultural idioms, or stereotypes about specific cultures.

Pairwise evaluation of model outputs using an LLM-as-a-judge (and human annotators) guided by specific criteria prompts on a 1-5 scale to detect favoritism, discrimination, or negative stereotyping toward any nationality or region.

Pairwise evaluation of model outputs using an LLM-as-a-judge (and human annotators) guided by specific criteria prompts on a 1-5 scale to detect if the content perpetuates racial or ethnic stereotypes or marginalizes certain groups.
